properties.description: The wire-level pin, against the real binary over stdio: one classed line per call, the harness named from the handshake, get_skill's name kept and no other argument, the requirement's id and statement absent from the ledger and the report, the window closing behind a report and not behind a peek. Shown to fail on an argument-leak mutation (4 pins) before it was trusted; a reply-text leak did NOT trip it, because reflow2's reply text does not carry the id — a limit worth knowing.
